item.title: Minimal common prefix and its two standard expressions

article.statement: Let I be an associate of J and a,b∉I distinct, with |Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I|<∞. There is an associate K and v_{a,b,I}:I→K left-divisible by v_{a,I},v_{b,I}, with exactly two standard expressions of equal factor count, starting respectively with these generators. Every BH morphism from I having both generators as length-additive left divisors has v_{a,b,I} as a left divisor. Thus this common multiple is minimal for left divisibility and standard-expression length.
article.locator: Lemma 4.15(1)–(2) and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: The same theorem with its finite relative-root hypothesis retained. It chooses v_{a,b,I}=(w_Dw_{D∩I})⁻¹ using FiniteRelativeLongest. The declared supporting endpoints separately establish elementary prefixes, simultaneous-prefix minimality and exactly two standard words.

translation.type:
∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S),
  let Obj := { L : Set S // ∃ g : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
  let component : Set S → S → Set S := fun L c => { d | d ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) c d }
  let parabolicRoots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) := fun L => { α | ∃ u : W, u ∈ CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs L ∧ ∃ i : S, i ∈ L ∧ CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs u (Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) = α }
  let leftDiv : W → W → Prop := fun u v => CoxeterSystem.length cs v = CoxeterSystem.length cs u + CoxeterSystem.length cs (u⁻¹ * v)
  ∀ (I : Obj) (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val),
    a ≠ b →
    Set.Finite (parabolicRoots (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) \ parabolicRoots I.val) →
    ∃ (hDa : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component I.val a))) (hDb : Finite (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs (component I.val b))),
    let va : W := (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hDa).1
    let vb : W := (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val b hb hDb).1
    ∃ (K : Obj) (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K) (ea eb : StandardExpressions cs J I K q),
      leftDiv va q.val ∧ leftDiv vb q.val ∧
      ea ≠ eb ∧
      (∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q, e = ea ∨ e = eb) ∧
      List.length ea.val = List.length eb.val ∧
      (∃ ta, ea.val = List.cons ⟨(I, a), ⟨ha, hDa⟩⟩ ta) ∧
      (∃ tb, eb.val = List.cons ⟨(I, b), ⟨hb, hDb⟩⟩ tb) ∧
      (∀ (K' : Obj) (w : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K'), leftDiv va w.val → leftDiv vb w.val → leftDiv q.val w.val ∧ ∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K' w, List.length ea.val ≤ List.length e.val)

items.title: Tits cone intersection and relative arrangement

article.statement: For J ⊆ Γ₀, let Θ_J = {f ∈ V*: f(α_j)=0 for every j∈J}. Define Cone(J)=Cone∩Θ_J, taking its interior in Θ_J. Define Φ^J={α∈Φ: Θ_J is not contained in H_α}=Φ\Φ_J and H^J={H_α∩Θ_J: α∈Φ^J_+}, counting coincident traces once.
article.locator: §3.1, printed p. 7, equations (3.1)–(3.3); §1.1.2, printed p. 2.

portal.statement: The same relative cone, roots and distinct hyperplane traces, explicitly using finite Γ₀ and the induced coordinate Euclidean topology. Neither W nor W_J is required to be finite.
portal.locator: Definition and Source notes of def-relative-cone-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Local finiteness in the relative interior

article.statement: Every u∈Cone(J)° belongs to an open ball in Cone(J) meeting only finitely many members of H^J. Consequently (Cone(J)°,H^J) is locally finite.
article.locator: Proposition 3.6, printed p. 9; Remark 3.7 distinguishes this from ambient local finiteness.

portal.statement: For finite Γ₀ and arbitrary J, every point of the relative interior has a relative Euclidean ball contained in Cone(J) meeting finitely many distinct relative hyperplanes. No spherical-type hypothesis is imposed.

items.title: Minimal coset labels classify relative chambers

article.statement: The map (x,I)↦xC_I bijects the chambers of (Cone(J)°,H^J) with Cham(J)={(x,I): W_Jx=xW_I and x has minimum length in xW_I}. Here C_I={f∈Θ_I: f(α_i)>0 for i∉I}.
article.locator: Theorem 3.9 and equation (3.10), printed pp. 9–10; equation (3.2), printed p. 7.

portal.statement: The same chamber-labelling bijection under the finite-rank geometric convention, for arbitrary Coxeter type and arbitrary J. The algebraic label set itself is available at arbitrary rank.
portal.locator: Statement, Facts & Assumptions and Source notes of thm-chamber-labelling-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Elementary crossing elements from spherical components

article.statement: For a∉I, let D=[I,a] be the component containing a in the diagram induced on I∪{a}. When W_D is finite, define v_{a,I}=w_{D\{a}}w_D, K=(I∪{a})\{ι_D(a)}, and ω_{a,I}(x,I)=(xv_{a,I},K). The opposition permutation satisfies w_Dα_i=−α_{ι_D(i)}. Finiteness is required of W_D, not of W_I or W_{I∪{a}}.
article.locator: Notation 3.13 and equations (3.14)–(3.15), printed p. 10; Notation 2.5 and equation (2.6), printed p. 5.

portal.statement: The same component-based construction on algebraic labels. Its definition initially gives a pair in W×P(Γ₀); preservation of chamber labels and geometric adjacency require subsequent results.

items.title: Adjacent chambers and inverse elementary crossings

article.statement: For adjacent chambers (x,I),(y,K), the common wall has unique describing indices a∉I and a′∉K, with I∪{a}=K∪{a′}. Their crossing components coincide and are spherical. The crossings satisfy ω_{a,I}(x,I)=(y,K), ω_{a′,K}(y,K)=(x,I), and v_{a,I}v_{a′,K}=v_{a′,K}v_{a,I}=1.
article.locator: Proposition 3.17 and following sentence, printed p. 11.

portal.statement: In finite rank, the common closed wall is the closure of xC_{I∪{a}} and of yC_{K∪{a′}}. The describing indices, finite crossing components, prescribed opposite labels and inverse products have the stated properties. Neither W_I nor W_{I∪{a}} is assumed finite.

items.title: Finite crossing paths connect relative chambers

article.statement: Any two chambers are related by a finite sequence of simple wall crossings.
article.locator: Lemma 3.20(3) and Remark 3.22, printed p. 11; Remark 3.8, printed p. 9.

portal.statement: For a finite-rank Coxeter system and arbitrary J, any two relative chambers are joined by finitely many component-based simple crossings. The empty sequence is allowed for equal endpoints.

items.title: Free normaliser-quotient action on chamber labels

article.statement: For ḡ∈N(W,J)=Norm_W(W_J)/W_J and any representative g, let y be the minimum-length element of gxW_I. Then ḡ·(x,I)=(y,I). Labels with the same second component form one orbit; the action is free and commutes with each defined adjacent crossing ω_{a,I}, preserving its index.
article.locator: Lemma 3.24(1)–(4), printed p. 12; underlying linear action in Lemma 3.23, printed p. 12.

portal.statement: The same free action, fibre-orbit description and crossing equivariance in the finite-rank relative chamber geometry, without requiring W or W_J finite.

items.title: Geodesicity equals Coxeter-length additivity

article.statement: For a chamber path p with consecutive crossing elements v₁,…,v_m and product v_p, p is geodesic if and only if ℓ(v_p)=Σ_i ℓ(v_i). Geodesic means having the minimum number of crossings between its endpoints.
article.locator: Proposition 3.29, printed pp. 13–14; path and geodesic conventions in §3.4, printed p. 13.

portal.statement: The same equivalence for finite-rank relative chamber paths, including the one-chamber path with empty product and sum. Its suppliers include the length/half-space criterion and translation between relative arrangements.

items.title: Brink–Howlett groupoid with the article's composition convention

article.statement: Fix a Coxeter diagram Γ, its Coxeter group W and J⊆Γ₀. An associate I of J has W_I conjugate to W_J. The groupoid BH(J) has these associates as objects and Hom_BH(I,K)={x∈W: x{α_k:k∈K}={α_i:i∈I}}. If x:I→K and y:K→L, their left-to-right composite is xy:I→L.
article.locator: §4.1, definition preceding Remark 4.1, printed p. 15; associates in Definition 2.7, printed p. 5.

portal.statement: The same small connected groupoid, with arrows tagged by source and target and multiplication read left to right. No finite-rank or spherical-type restriction is imposed.

items.title: Elementary crossings are Brink–Howlett arrows

article.statement: If I is an associate of J, a∉I and W_[I,a] is finite, then v_{a,I}∈Hom_BH(I,(I∪{a})\{ι_[I,a](a)}).
article.locator: Lemma 4.2, printed p. 15.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, the prescribed target K is an associate of J and v_{a,I}{α_k:k∈K}={α_i:i∈I}. Only the crossing component is required to be spherical.

items.title: Singleton-arrow groupoid on chamber labels

article.statement: The groupoid BH̃(J) has objects Cham(J), with Hom((x,I),(y,K)) the singleton labelled x⁻¹y. Composition multiplies labels on the right. For adjacent chambers its arrow is labelled by their elementary crossing element.
article.locator: Definition 4.3 and following paragraph, printed p. 15.

portal.statement: The algebraic singleton-arrow construction applies at arbitrary rank, retaining endpoint tags. Its geometric chamber and adjacent-crossing interpretation additionally uses finite rank, without assuming W, W_I or W_{I∪{a}} finite.

items.title: Adjacent crossings generate the universal wall groupoid

article.statement: For any chamber labels (x,I),(y,K), there is a finite crossing path p between them whose product v_p equals x⁻¹y. Thus the adjacent-crossing arrows generate BH̃(J). The path need not be unique.
article.locator: Proposition 4.4, printed p. 16.

portal.statement: The same factorization through finite paths in the finite-rank relative-interior arrangement, with endpoint-tagged arrows and the zero-crossing case included.

items.title: Chamber labels and prescribed-source arrow lifting

article.statement: For associates I,K of J: (1) chamber labels (x,I),(y,K) satisfy x⁻¹y∈Hom_BH(I,K); (2) if w∈Hom_BH(I,K) and (x,I)∈Cham(J), then (xw,K)∈Cham(J), and w labels the arrow upstairs from (x,I) to (xw,K).
article.locator: Proposition 4.6(1)–(2), printed p. 16.

portal.statement: The same assertions are stated with finite-rank hypotheses and geometric chamber identification. The main covering entry separately supplies an arbitrary-rank algebraic correspondence using canonical simple systems.

items.title: Theorem 1.3 / 4.7: universal covering, wall crossings and deck quotient

article.statement: Let Γ be a Coxeter diagram with Coxeter group W and J⊆Γ₀. The functor F:BH̃(J)→BH(J), defined by F(x,I)=I and F(x⁻¹y)=x⁻¹y, is a universal groupoid covering with Deck(F)≅N(W,J). Preserve also Theorem 1.3's geometric content: its upstairs objects are the chambers of (Cone(J)°,H^J), its generating morphisms are simple crossings between adjacent chambers, and BH(J) is obtained as the N(W,J)-quotient of BH̃(J). No spherical-type restriction on W or W_J is stated.
article.locator: Theorem 1.3 and following paragraph, printed p. 2; Theorem 4.7, printed pp. 16–17; Definition 4.3, printed p. 15; Proposition 4.4, printed p. 16.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, the algebraic label groupoid covers BH(J) universally, has deck group N(W,J), and has quotient isomorphic to BH(J). Its geometric chamber identification, adjacent-generator interpretation and generation assertion explicitly use finite rank. Neither W nor W_J is required finite. This scope distinction remains explicit and is not substituted for the original requested statement.
portal.locator: Statement, External input and Source notes of thm-universal-brink-howlett-cover-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Length-additive elementary expressions

article.statement: For w∈Hom_BH(I,K), a standard expression is a finite composable product w=v_{a₁,I₁}⋯v_{a_m,I_m}, starting at I and ending at K, with ℓ(w)=Σ_iℓ(v_{a_i,I_i}). Its expression length is m. Existence and independence of the expression are subsequent assertions, not assumptions of this definition.
article.locator: Definition 4.9, printed p. 17.

portal.statement: The same definition at arbitrary rank. Each elementary factor requires its crossing component spherical. The empty expression represents an identity. The notation ℓ_BH(w) is introduced only after existence and invariance of factor count are established.

items.title: Standard expressions lift to geodesic paths

article.statement: A composable sequence of simple wall crossings is a geodesic path exactly when its product is a standard expression in BH. Every w∈Hom_BH(I,K) has a standard expression; its lift from (x,I) ends at (xw,K).
article.locator: Lemma 4.10 and equations (4.11)–(4.12), printed p. 18.

portal.statement: In finite rank, each standard expression has a unique geodesic lift from any prescribed chamber of its source type. For specified crossings, target-source compatibility is required. The empty expression corresponds to a one-chamber path. This geometric supplier alone does not establish arbitrary-rank existence.

items.title: Arbitrary-rank existence and parallel-class factor count

article.statement: No standalone article statement gives the parallel-class formula selected here. This is a portal helper supporting existence of standard expressions and invariance of their factor count; the parent article assertions are Lemma 4.10 and Corollary 4.13.
article.locator: Parent results: Lemma 4.10 and Corollary 4.13, printed p. 18. The formula m=|C(w)| is not attributed to an article lemma.

portal.statement: Every article morphism w has a standard expression. If an expression has m factors, then m=|C(w)|, using the opposite root-action arrow with the same label. Here C(w) is the finite set of real parallel classes contained in its positive inversion set. Its declared algebraic suppliers allow arbitrary rank.
portal.locator: Statement and Facts & Assumptions of lem-author-b19d43a8e520-bh-standard-factor-count; source references are empty, so article attribution is only through the stated parent results.

items.title: Elementary generation and invariance of standard length

article.statement: BH(J) is generated by v_{a,I} for associates I and a∉I with W_[I,a] finite. Any two standard expressions of the same morphism, with the same source, have the same number of factors.
article.locator: Corollary 4.13(1)–(2), printed p. 18.

portal.statement: The same generation and equal-factor-count assertions. Its current proof suppliers use the arbitrary-rank StandardFactorCount endpoint rather than relying on finite-rank chamber geometry.

items.title: Finite relative longest element inside an arbitrary system

article.statement: No standalone article lemma states this full construction and inversion-set formula. It is a portal helper for Lemma 4.15: finite Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I allows construction inside the union of the components meeting {a,b}, without making I or the ambient system spherical.
article.locator: Parent result: Lemma 4.15 and equation (4.16), printed p. 19; related inverse characterization in Remark 4.17, printed p. 19.

portal.statement: At arbitrary rank, let a,b∉I be distinct, T=I∪{a,b}, and Φ_T\Φ_I finite. Let D be the union of components of T meeting {a,b}. Then W_D is finite. For r=w_Dw_{D∩I}, rΠ_I=Π_K for an associate K⊆T; q=r⁻¹ is an article morphism I→K and N(q)=Φ_T⁺\Φ_I⁺, where N(x)=Φ⁺∩xΦ⁻.

items.title: Minimal common prefix and its two standard expressions

article.statement: Let I be an associate of J and a,b∉I distinct, with |Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I|<∞. There is an associate K and v_{a,b,I}:I→K left-divisible by v_{a,I},v_{b,I}, with exactly two standard expressions of equal factor count, starting respectively with these generators. Every BH morphism from I having both generators as length-additive left divisors has v_{a,b,I} as a left divisor. Thus this common multiple is minimal for left divisibility and standard-expression length.
article.locator: Lemma 4.15(1)–(2) and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: The same theorem with its finite relative-root hypothesis retained. It chooses v_{a,b,I}=(w_Dw_{D∩I})⁻¹ using FiniteRelativeLongest. The declared supporting endpoints separately establish elementary prefixes, simultaneous-prefix minimality and exactly two standard words.

items.title: Atomic braid relations and contextual replacements

article.statement: Under Lemma 4.15's hypotheses, equating the two standard expressions of v_{a,b,I} in (4.16) is an atomic braid relation.
article.locator: Definition 4.18, Lemma 4.15 and equation (4.16), printed p. 19.

portal.statement: For distinct a,b outside an associate I with finite Φ_{I∪{a,b}}\Φ_I, the equality of the two supplied standard expressions defines the atomic braid relation. In the main theorem a move replaces either side inside a composable expression, retaining the surrounding factors.
portal.locator: Definition of def-atomic-braid-artin-tits-normalisers; contextual use in the Statement of thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers.

items.title: Theorem 1.4 / 4.21: Atomic Matsumoto

article.statement: Let Γ be a Coxeter diagram, J⊆Γ₀, BH(J) its Brink–Howlett groupoid, and I,K associates of J. Any two standard expressions of w∈Hom_BH(I,K) are related by a sequence of atomic braid relations. Preserve the arbitrary-Coxeter-type scope: neither W, W_J, nor the enlarged parabolics W_{I∪{a}} are globally assumed finite. Standard expressions and atomic braid relations have exactly the meanings of Definitions 4.9 and 4.18.
article.locator: Theorem 1.4, printed p. 3; Theorem 4.21 and Remark 4.22, printed p. 20; Definitions 4.9 and 4.18, printed pp. 17 and 19.

portal.statement: For a Coxeter system without rank or type restriction, arbitrary J and associates I,K, any two finite length-additive elementary expressions of the same morphism w:I→K are connected by finitely many atomic braid relations. The finite relative-root condition needed for a two-generator relation is derived from the common prefixes; it is not added as a hypothesis of the main theorem.
portal.locator: Statement, Facts & Assumptions and External input of thm-atomic-matsumoto-artin-tits-normalisers.

BrinkHowlettGroupoid.type: ∀ {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S), CategoryTheory.Groupoid { I : Set S // ∃ w : W, Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj w)) (CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs I) = CoxeterSystem.parabolic cs J }
BrinkHowlettGroupoid.value:
by
  intro S W inst M cs J
  let roots : Set S → Set (Finsupp S Real) :=
    fun I => Set.image (fun i : S => Finsupp.single i (1 : Real)) I
  exact {
    Hom := fun I K => { w : W //
      Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs w) (roots K.val) = roots I.val }
    id := fun I => ⟨1, by simp⟩
    comp := fun {I K L} x y => ⟨x.val * y.val, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs (x.val * y.val)) (roots L.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs y.val) (roots L.val)) := by
                  simp only [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, Set.image_image]
        _ = roots I.val := by rw [y.property, x.property]⟩
    id_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (one_mul x.val)
    comp_id := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_one x.val)
    assoc := fun x y z => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val)
    inv := fun {I K} x => ⟨x.val⁻¹, by
      calc
        Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹) (roots I.val)
            = Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)
                (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val) (roots K.val)) :=
                  congrArg (Set.image (CoxeterSystem.geometricRepresentation cs x.val⁻¹)) x.property.symm
        _ = roots K.val := by
          simp only [Set.image_image, Representation.inv_self_apply, Set.image_id']⟩
    inv_comp := fun x => Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel x.val)
    comp_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel x.val)
  }

import ArtinDeligne
import Proofs.FiniteRelativeLongest
import Proofs.StandardExpressions

noncomputable section
namespace ResidueConfinement
variable {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W)

def component (L : Set S) (c : S) : Set S :=
  {d | d ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) c d}

def support (I : Set S) (a b : S) : Set S :=
  let T := Set.insert a (Set.insert b I)
  {i | i ∈ T ∧ (Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun j k : S => j ∈ T ∧ k ∈ T ∧ j ≠ k ∧ M j k ≠ 2) a i ∨
    Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun j k : S => j ∈ T ∧ k ∈ T ∧ j ≠ k ∧ M j k ≠ 2) b i)}

def orbitRoots (L : Set S) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) :=
  {x | ∃ w : W, w ∈ cs.parabolic L ∧ ∃ i ∈ L,
    cs.geometricRepresentation w (Finsupp.single i 1) = x}

def inversions (w : W) : Set (S →₀ ℝ) :=
  {x | x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < x} ∩
    cs.geometricRepresentation w '' {x | x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ x < 0}

theorem mem_inversions (w : W) (x : S →₀ ℝ) :
    x ∈ inversions cs w ↔ x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < x ∧
      cs.geometricRepresentation w⁻¹ x < 0 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hr, hp⟩, y, ⟨_, hn⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hr, hp, by simpa only [Representation.inv_self_apply] using hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨hr, hp, hn⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hr, hp⟩, cs.geometricRepresentation w⁻¹ x,
      ⟨(cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff _).mpr hr, hn⟩,
      Representation.self_inv_apply _ _ _⟩

theorem inversion_unique {u v : W} (h : inversions cs u = inversions cs v) : u = v := by
  have pref (x y : W) (hxy : inversions cs x ⊆ inversions cs y) :
      cs.length y = cs.length x + cs.length (x⁻¹ * y) := by
    apply (ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.length_eq_add_iff_rootInversions_subset_system cs x y).mpr
    intro r hr hp hn
    exact ((mem_inversions cs y r).mp
      (hxy ((mem_inversions cs x r).mpr ⟨hr, hp, hn⟩))).2.2
  have huv := pref u v (by rw [h])
  have hvu := pref v u (by rw [h])
  have hz : u⁻¹ * v = 1 := cs.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega)
  exact (inv_mul_eq_one.mp hz)

theorem canonical_label (I : Set S) (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I) (hb : b ∉ I)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hf : Set.Finite (orbitRoots cs (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I)) \ orbitRoots cs I))
    (q : W) (hq : inversions cs q =
      (orbitRoots cs (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I)) ∩ {x | x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < x}) \
        (orbitRoots cs I ∩ {x | x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < x})) :
    Finite (cs.parabolic (support (M := M) I a b)) ∧
    ∃ d : cs.parabolic (support (M := M) I a b),
    ∃ j : cs.parabolic (support (M := M) I a b ∩ I),
      q = ((d : W) * (j : W))⁻¹ ∧ q ∈ cs.parabolic (support (M := M) I a b) := by
  obtain ⟨hD, d, j, _, _, K, _, _, _, _, hN⟩ := FiniteRelativeLongest cs I a b ha hb hab hf
  have he : q = ((d : W) * (j : W))⁻¹ := inversion_unique cs (hq.trans hN.symm)
  refine ⟨hD, d, j, he, ?_⟩
  rw [he]
  exact inv_mem (mul_mem d.property (cs.parabolic_mono Set.inter_subset_left j.property))

theorem outside (L : Set S) (w : W) (hw : w ∈ cs.parabolic L)
    (k : S) (hk : k ∉ L) (x : S →₀ ℝ) :
    cs.geometricRepresentation w x k = x k := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_wordProd_eq_of_mem_parabolic hw
  clear hw
  induction u with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i u ih =>
    have hki : k ≠ i := fun h => hk (h ▸ hu i (by simp))
    rw [cs.wordProd_cons, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp,
      cs.geometricRepresentation_simple, M.geometricReflection_apply_apply_of_ne hki]
    exact ih (fun j hj => hu j (by simp [hj]))

theorem index_mem_of_simple_mem {D : Set S} {i : S}
    (hi : cs.simple i ∈ cs.parabolic D) : i ∈ D := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hD, hp⟩ := cs.exists_isReduced_wordProd_eq_of_mem_parabolic hi
  have hl : u.length = 1 := by rw [← hu.eq, hp, cs.length_simple]
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hl
  have hij : j = i := cs.simple_injective (by simpa using hp)
  exact hij ▸ hD j (by simp)

theorem factors_mem {A : Type*} (label : A → W) (es : List A) (D : Set S)
    (hadd : cs.length (es.map label).prod = (es.map (fun e => cs.length (label e))).sum)
    (hprod : (es.map label).prod ∈ cs.parabolic D) :
    ∀ e ∈ es, label e ∈ cs.parabolic D := by
  classical
  choose word hred hword using (fun e : A => cs.exists_isReduced (label e))
  have prod_eq (es : List A) : cs.wordProd (es.flatMap word) = (es.map label).prod := by
    induction es with
    | nil => simp
    | cons e es ih => simp [cs.wordProd_append, ih, ← hword e]
  have len_eq (es : List A) : (es.flatMap word).length =
      (es.map (fun e => cs.length (label e))).sum := by
    induction es with
    | nil => simp
    | cons e es ih => simp [ih, ← (hred e).eq, ← hword e]
  have hr : cs.IsReduced (es.flatMap word) := by
    change cs.length (cs.wordProd (es.flatMap word)) = (es.flatMap word).length
    rw [prod_eq, len_eq]
    exact hadd
  have hall : ∀ i ∈ es.flatMap word, i ∈ D := fun i hi =>
    index_mem_of_simple_mem cs (cs.simple_mem_parabolic_of_isReduced _ hr (by rwa [prod_eq]) i hi)
  intro e he
  rw [hword e]
  exact cs.wordProd_mem_parabolic (fun i hi => hall i (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨e, he, hi⟩))

theorem crossing_index_mem (L D : Set S) (c : S) (hc : c ∉ L)
    (hF : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) L c)))
    (hv : (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs L c hc hF).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D) : c ∈ D := by
  classical
  let F := component (M := M) L c
  letI : Finite (cs.parabolic F) := hF
  let subfinite (A : Set S) (hA : A ⊆ F) : Finite (cs.parabolic A) :=
    Finite.of_injective (fun w : cs.parabolic A =>
      (⟨w.val, cs.parabolic_mono hA w.property⟩ : cs.parabolic F))
      (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : cs.parabolic F => z.val) h))
  let longest (A : Set S) (hA : A ⊆ F) : cs.parabolic A :=
    letI := subfinite A hA
    Classical.choose (Finite.exists_max (fun w : cs.parabolic A => cs.length w.val))
  have maxF (u : cs.parabolic F) : cs.length u.val ≤
      cs.length (longest F (fun _ h => h)).val := by
    letI := subfinite F (fun _ h => h)
    exact Classical.choose_spec (Finite.exists_max
      (fun w : cs.parabolic F => cs.length w.val)) u
  let d : cs.parabolic F := longest F (fun _ h => h)
  let j : cs.parabolic (F \ {c}) := longest (F \ {c}) Set.sdiff_subset
  change (j : W) * (d : W) ∈ cs.parabolic D at hv
  have hcF : c ∈ F := ⟨Set.mem_insert _ _, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  have hm := maxF ⟨d.val * cs.simple c, mul_mem d.property (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hcF)⟩
  have hn : cs.geometricRepresentation d.val (Finsupp.single c (1 : ℝ)) < 0 := by
    apply (cs.geometricRepresentation_single_neg_iff _ c).mpr
    change cs.length (d.val * cs.simple c) < cs.length d.val
    have hdich := cs.length_mul_simple d.val c
    change cs.length (d.val * cs.simple c) ≤ cs.length d.val at hm
    rcases hdich with h | h <;> omega
  by_contra hcD
  have ho := outside cs D (j.val * d.val) hv c hcD (Finsupp.single c 1)
  rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, outside cs (F \ {c}) j.val j.property c (by simp)] at ho
  have hle : cs.geometricRepresentation d.val (Finsupp.single c (1 : ℝ)) c ≤ 0 := hn.le c
  simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at ho
  linarith

theorem support_facts (I : Set S) (a b : S) :
    a ∈ support (M := M) I a b ∧ b ∈ support (M := M) I a b ∧
    support (M := M) I a b ⊆ Set.insert a (Set.insert b I) ∧
    (∀ i ∈ support (M := M) I a b, ∀ j ∈ I \ support (M := M) I a b, M i j = 2) := by
  let T := Set.insert a (Set.insert b I)
  let D := support (M := M) I a b
  have haD : a ∈ D := ⟨Set.mem_insert _ _, Or.inl Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  have hbD : b ∈ D := ⟨Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _), Or.inr Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  refine ⟨haD, hbD, fun _ h => h.1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi j hj
  by_contra hij
  have hne : i ≠ j := fun he => hj.2 (he ▸ hi)
  have edge : i ∈ T ∧ j ∈ T ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2 :=
    ⟨hi.1, Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hj.1), hne, hij⟩
  apply hj.2
  exact ⟨edge.2.1, hi.2.elim
    (fun hp => Or.inl (hp.tail edge)) (fun hp => Or.inr (hp.tail edge))⟩

def State (D E L : Set S) : Prop :=
  ∃ x ∈ D, ∃ y ∈ D, x ≠ y ∧ L = E ∪ (D \ {x, y})

theorem initial_state (I : Set S) (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I) (hb : b ∉ I) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    State (support (M := M) I a b) (I \ support (M := M) I a b) I := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨haD, hbD, hDT, _⟩ := support_facts (M := M) I a b
  refine ⟨a, haD, b, hbD, hab, ?_⟩
  ext t
  have hT : t ∈ support (M := M) I a b → t = a ∨ t = b ∨ t ∈ I := fun h => hDT h
  change t ∈ I ↔ (t ∈ I ∧ t ∉ support (M := M) I a b) ∨
    (t ∈ support (M := M) I a b ∧ ¬ (t = a ∨ t = b))
  constructor
  · intro hi
    by_cases hd : t ∈ support (M := M) I a b
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hd, fun h => h.elim (fun h => ha (h ▸ hi)) (fun h => hb (h ▸ hi))⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hi, hd⟩
  · rintro (⟨hi, _⟩ | ⟨hd, hn⟩)
    · exact hi
    · rcases hT hd with he | he | hi
      · exact False.elim (hn (Or.inl he))
      · exact False.elim (hn (Or.inr he))
      · exact hi

theorem component_subset (D E L : Set S) (hsep : ∀ i ∈ D, ∀ j ∈ E, M i j = 2)
    (hL : State D E L) (c : S) (hcD : c ∈ D) : component (M := M) L c ⊆ D := by
  obtain ⟨x, _, y, _, _, rfl⟩ := hL
  intro d hd
  have H : ∀ d, Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert c (E ∪ (D \ {x, y})) ∧
        j ∈ Set.insert c (E ∪ (D \ {x, y})) ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) c d → d ∈ D := by
    intro d hp
    induction hp with
    | refl => exact hcD
    | @tail d e hp edge ih =>
      by_cases he : e ∈ D
      · exact he
      have heE : e ∈ E := by
        rcases edge.2.1 with rfl | hE | hD
        · exact False.elim (he hcD)
        · exact hE
        · exact False.elim (he hD.1)
      exact False.elim (edge.2.2.2 (hsep d ih e heE))
  exact H d hd.2

theorem target_shape (L : Set S) (c : S) (hc : c ∉ L)
    (hF : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) L c))) :
    ∃ t ∈ component (M := M) L c,
      (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs L c hc hF).2.1 = Set.insert c L \ {t} := by
  classical
  unfold SimpleWallCrossings
  dsimp only
  exact ⟨_, Subtype.property _, rfl⟩

theorem set_swap (D E : Set S) (x y t : S) (hx : x ∈ D)
    (htE : t ∉ E) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hty : t ≠ y) :
    Set.insert x (E ∪ (D \ {x, y})) \ {t} = E ∪ (D \ {t, y}) := by
  classical
  ext k
  change ((k = x ∨ k ∈ E ∨ (k ∈ D ∧ ¬(k = x ∨ k = y))) ∧ k ≠ t) ↔
    k ∈ E ∨ (k ∈ D ∧ ¬(k = t ∨ k = y))
  by_cases hkx : k = x
  · subst k
    aesop
  · by_cases hkt : k = t
    · subst k
      aesop
    · tauto

theorem state_step (D E L : Set S) (hdis : Disjoint D E)
    (hsep : ∀ i ∈ D, ∀ j ∈ E, M i j = 2) (hL : State D E L)
    (c : S) (hc : c ∉ L) (hcD : c ∈ D)
    (hF : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) L c))) :
    State D E (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs L c hc hF).2.1 := by
  classical
  have hFD := component_subset D E L hsep hL c hcD
  obtain ⟨t, ht, heq⟩ := target_shape cs L c hc hF
  have htD := hFD ht
  have htL : t ∈ Set.insert c L := ht.1
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, hL⟩ := hL
  have hcxy : c = x ∨ c = y := by
    by_contra hn
    apply hc
    rw [hL]
    right
    exact ⟨hcD, by simpa using hn⟩
  have htE : t ∉ E := fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdis htD h
  have case_x (x y : S) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D) (hxy : x ≠ y)
      (hL : L = E ∪ (D \ {x, y})) (hc : c = x) :
      State D E (Set.insert c L \ {t}) := by
    have hty : t ≠ y := by
      intro he
      subst t
      rcases htL with he | he
      · exact hxy (hc.symm.trans he.symm)
      · rw [hL] at he
        rcases he with he | he
        · exact htE he
        · exact he.2 (by simp)
    refine ⟨t, htD, y, hy, hty, ?_⟩
    rw [hL, hc]
    exact set_swap D E x y t hx htE hxy hty
  rcases hcxy with hcx | hcy
  · rw [heq]
    exact case_x x y hx hy hxy hL hcx
  · rw [heq]
    apply case_x y x hy hx hxy.symm _ hcy
    simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using hL

abbrev Obj (J : Set S) := {L : Set S // ∃ g : W,
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (cs.parabolic L) = cs.parabolic J}
abbrev Atom (J : Set S) := {p : Obj cs J × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧
  Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) p.1.val p.2))}
def crossing {J : Set S} (e : Atom cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2

def Composable {J : Set S} (es : List (Atom cs J)) (L K : Set S) : Prop :=
  List.foldr (fun e tail N => N = e.val.1.val ∧ tail (crossing cs e).2.1)
    (fun N => N = K) es L

theorem word_states {J : Set S} (D E : Set S) (hdis : Disjoint D E)
    (hsep : ∀ i ∈ D, ∀ j ∈ E, M i j = 2)
    (es : List (Atom cs J)) (L K : Set S) (hcomp : Composable cs es L K)
    (hstart : State D E L)
    (hmem : ∀ e ∈ es, (crossing cs e).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D) :
    State D E K ∧ ∀ e ∈ es,
      State D E e.val.1.val ∧ e.val.2 ∈ D ∧ component (M := M) e.val.1.val e.val.2 ⊆ D := by
  induction es generalizing L with
  | nil =>
    change L = K at hcomp
    subst L
    exact ⟨hstart, by simp⟩
  | cons e es ih =>
    obtain ⟨hsource, htail⟩ := hcomp
    subst L
    have hcD := crossing_index_mem cs e.val.1.val D e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
      (hmem e (by simp))
    have hFD := component_subset D E e.val.1.val hsep hstart e.val.2 hcD
    have hnext := state_step cs D E e.val.1.val hdis hsep hstart e.val.2 e.property.1 hcD e.property.2
    obtain ⟨hend, hall⟩ := ih _ htail hnext (fun t ht => hmem t (by simp [ht]))
    refine ⟨hend, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp ht with rfl | ht
    · exact ⟨hstart, hcD, hFD⟩
    · exact hall t ht

theorem standard_residue (J : Set S) (I K : Obj cs J) (a b : S)
    (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : Set.Finite (orbitRoots cs (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) \ orbitRoots cs I.val))
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (hq : inversions cs q.val =
      (orbitRoots cs (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) ∩ {x | x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < x}) \
        (orbitRoots cs I.val ∩ {x | x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < x}))
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q) :
    let D := support (M := M) I.val a b
    let E := I.val \ D
    Finite (cs.parabolic D) ∧ State D E K.val ∧
      ∀ t ∈ e.val, (crossing cs t).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D ∧
        State D E t.val.1.val ∧ t.val.2 ∈ D ∧ component (M := M) t.val.1.val t.val.2 ⊆ D := by
  let D := support (M := M) I.val a b
  let E := I.val \ D
  obtain ⟨hD, d, j, hcanon, hqD⟩ := canonical_label cs I.val a b ha hb hab hf q.val hq
  have hfac : ∀ t ∈ e.val, (crossing cs t).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D := by
    have hp : (e.val.map (fun t : Atom cs J => (crossing cs t).1)).prod = q.val := e.property.2.1
    have hl : cs.length (e.val.map (fun t : Atom cs J => (crossing cs t).1)).prod =
        (e.val.map (fun t => cs.length (crossing cs t).1)).sum := by
      rw [hp]
      exact e.property.2.2
    apply factors_mem cs (fun t : Atom cs J => (crossing cs t).1) e.val D hl
    rw [hp]
    exact hqD
  have hcomp : Composable cs e.val I.val K.val := e.property.1
  have hdis : Disjoint D E := Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun _ hd he => he.2 hd)
  have hsep : ∀ i ∈ D, ∀ j ∈ E, M i j = 2 := (support_facts (M := M) I.val a b).2.2.2
  obtain ⟨hend, hall⟩ := word_states cs D E hdis hsep e.val I.val K.val hcomp
    (initial_state (M := M) I.val a b ha hb hab) hfac
  exact ⟨hD, hend, fun t ht => ⟨hfac t ht, hall t ht⟩⟩

theorem state_missing_pair (D E L : Set S) (hdis : Disjoint D E) (hL : State D E L) :
    ∃ x ∈ D, ∃ y ∈ D, x ≠ y ∧ D \ L = {x, y} := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, rfl⟩ := hL
  refine ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, ?_⟩
  ext k
  have hDE : k ∈ D → k ∉ E := fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdis h
  change (k ∈ D ∧ ¬ (k ∈ E ∨ (k ∈ D ∧ ¬ (k = x ∨ k = y)))) ↔ k = x ∨ k = y
  constructor
  · tauto
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨hx, by tauto⟩
    · exact ⟨hy, by tauto⟩

theorem atom_ext {J : Set S} (e f : Atom cs J)
    (hs : e.val.1.val = f.val.1.val) (hi : e.val.2 = f.val.2) : e = f :=
  Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hs) hi)

theorem outgoing_indices {J : Set S} (D E L : Set S) (hdis : Disjoint D E)
    (hL : State D E L) :
    ∃ x ∈ D, ∃ y ∈ D, x ≠ y ∧ ∀ t : Atom cs J,
      t.val.1.val = L → (crossing cs t).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D →
      t.val.2 = x ∨ t.val.2 = y := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, hmiss⟩ := state_missing_pair D E L hdis hL
  refine ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, ?_⟩
  intro t hs ht
  have hcD := crossing_index_mem cs t.val.1.val D t.val.2 t.property.1 t.property.2 ht
  have hcL : t.val.2 ∉ L := hs ▸ t.property.1
  have hm : t.val.2 ∈ D \ L := ⟨hcD, hcL⟩
  rw [hmiss] at hm
  exact hm

def CorankTwoInvariant (J D E L : Set S) : Prop :=
  State D E L ∧ ∃ x ∈ D, ∃ y ∈ D, x ≠ y ∧ D \ L = {x, y} ∧
    (∀ t : Atom cs J, t.val.1.val = L →
      (crossing cs t).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D → t.val.2 = x ∨ t.val.2 = y) ∧
    (∀ t u v : Atom cs J,
      t.val.1.val = L → u.val.1.val = L → v.val.1.val = L →
      (crossing cs t).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D →
      (crossing cs u).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D →
      (crossing cs v).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D →
      t ≠ u → t ≠ v → u = v)

theorem outgoing_eq_of_ne {J : Set S} (D E L : Set S) (hdis : Disjoint D E)
    (hL : State D E L) (t u v : Atom cs J)
    (ht : t.val.1.val = L) (hu : u.val.1.val = L) (hv : v.val.1.val = L)
    (htD : (crossing cs t).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D)
    (huD : (crossing cs u).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D)
    (hvD : (crossing cs v).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D)
    (htu : t ≠ u) (htv : t ≠ v) : u = v := by
  obtain ⟨x, _, y, _, _, hout⟩ := outgoing_indices cs D E L hdis hL
  have eq_index (p r : Atom cs J) (hp : p.val.1.val = L)
      (hr : r.val.1.val = L) (hi : p.val.2 = r.val.2) : p = r :=
    atom_ext cs p r (hp.trans hr.symm) hi
  rcases hout t ht htD with htx | hty
  · have huy : u.val.2 = y := (hout u hu huD).resolve_left
      (fun hux => htu (eq_index t u ht hu (htx.trans hux.symm)))
    have hvy : v.val.2 = y := (hout v hv hvD).resolve_left
      (fun hvx => htv (eq_index t v ht hv (htx.trans hvx.symm)))
    exact eq_index u v hu hv (huy.trans hvy.symm)
  · have hux : u.val.2 = x := (hout u hu huD).resolve_right
      (fun huy => htu (eq_index t u ht hu (hty.trans huy.symm)))
    have hvx : v.val.2 = x := (hout v hv hvD).resolve_right
      (fun hvy => htv (eq_index t v ht hv (hty.trans hvy.symm)))
    exact eq_index u v hu hv (hux.trans hvx.symm)

theorem corank_two_at_state (J D E L : Set S) (hdis : Disjoint D E)
    (hL : State D E L) : CorankTwoInvariant cs J D E L := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, hmiss⟩ := state_missing_pair D E L hdis hL
  refine ⟨hL, x, hx, y, hy, hxy, hmiss, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht htD
    have hi := crossing_index_mem cs t.val.1.val D t.val.2
      t.property.1 t.property.2 htD
    have hm : t.val.2 ∈ D \ L := ⟨hi, ht ▸ t.property.1⟩
    rw [hmiss] at hm
    exact hm
  · exact fun t u v ht hu hv htD huD hvD htu htv =>
      outgoing_eq_of_ne cs D E L hdis hL t u v ht hu hv htD huD hvD htu htv

theorem standard_corank_two (J : Set S) (I K : Obj cs J) (a b : S)
    (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : Set.Finite (orbitRoots cs (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) \ orbitRoots cs I.val))
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (hq : inversions cs q.val =
      (orbitRoots cs (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) ∩ {x | x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < x}) \
        (orbitRoots cs I.val ∩ {x | x ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < x}))
    (e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q) :
    let D := support (M := M) I.val a b
    let E := I.val \ D
    Finite (cs.parabolic D) ∧ q.val ∈ cs.parabolic D ∧
      CorankTwoInvariant cs J D E I.val ∧ CorankTwoInvariant cs J D E K.val ∧
      ∀ t ∈ e.val, (crossing cs t).1 ∈ cs.parabolic D ∧
        CorankTwoInvariant cs J D E t.val.1.val ∧
        t.val.2 ∈ D ∧ component (M := M) t.val.1.val t.val.2 ⊆ D := by
  let D := support (M := M) I.val a b
  let E := I.val \ D
  have hdis : Disjoint D E := Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun _ hd he => he.2 hd)
  obtain ⟨hD, hend, hall⟩ := standard_residue cs J I K a b ha hb hab hf q hq e
  obtain ⟨_, d, j, _, hqD⟩ := canonical_label cs I.val a b ha hb hab hf q.val hq
  refine ⟨hD, hqD,
    corank_two_at_state cs J D E I.val hdis (initial_state I.val a b ha hb hab),
    corank_two_at_state cs J D E K.val hdis hend, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨htD, hstate, hindex, hcomp⟩ := hall t ht
  exact ⟨htD, corank_two_at_state cs J D E t.val.1.val hdis hstate, hindex, hcomp⟩

end ResidueConfinement

def component (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (I : Set S) (a : S) : Set S :=
  {b | b ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) a b}

def subfinite (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (D : Set S)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) (L : Set S) (hL : L ⊆ D) :
    Finite (cs.parabolic L) := by
  letI := hD
  exact Finite.of_injective
    (fun w : cs.parabolic L => (⟨(w : W), (cs.parabolic_mono hL) w.property⟩ : cs.parabolic D))
    (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : cs.parabolic D => (z : W)) h))

def longest (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (D : Set S)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) (L : Set S) (hL : L ⊆ D) : cs.parabolic L :=
  letI := subfinite cs D hD L hL
  Classical.choose (Finite.exists_max (fun w : cs.parabolic L => cs.length (w : W)))

theorem longest_max (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (D : Set S)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) (L : Set S) (hL : L ⊆ D) :
    ∀ u : cs.parabolic L, cs.length (u : W) ≤ cs.length (longest cs D hD L hL : W) := by
  letI := subfinite cs D hD L hL
  exact Classical.choose_spec (Finite.exists_max (fun w : cs.parabolic L => cs.length (w : W)))

def opposition (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (D : Set S) (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) : D ≃ D :=
  @Classical.epsilon (D ≃ D) ⟨Equiv.refl D⟩
    (fun e => ∀ i : D, cs.geometricRepresentation
      (longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h) : W) (Finsupp.single (i : S) (1 : ℝ)) =
        -Finsupp.single (e i : S) 1)

theorem opposition_certified (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (D : Set S)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) :
    let z : W := longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
    let ν := opposition cs D hD
    z * z = 1 ∧ Function.Involutive ν ∧
      (∀ i : D, cs.geometricRepresentation z (Finsupp.single (i : S) (1 : ℝ)) =
        -Finsupp.single (ν i : S) 1) ∧
      (∀ i : D, z * cs.simple (i : S) * z⁻¹ = cs.simple (ν i : S)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨zz, e, heinv, heroot, hegen⟩ := oppositionWork cs D
    (longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)) (longest_max cs D hD D (fun _ h => h))
  have hroot : ∀ i : D, cs.geometricRepresentation
      (longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h) : W) (Finsupp.single (i : S) (1 : ℝ)) =
        -Finsupp.single (opposition cs D hD i : S) 1 :=
    Classical.epsilon_spec_aux ⟨Equiv.refl D⟩
      (fun e : D ≃ D => ∀ i : D, cs.geometricRepresentation
        (longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h) : W) (Finsupp.single (i : S) (1 : ℝ)) =
          -Finsupp.single (e i : S) 1) ⟨e, heroot⟩
  have heq : opposition cs D hD = e := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.single_left_injective (show (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
    exact neg_injective ((hroot i).symm.trans (heroot i))
  exact ⟨zz, by simpa only [heq] using heinv, hroot, by simpa only [heq] using hegen⟩

theorem crossing_data (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S) (a : S)
    (ha : a ∉ I) (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M I a))) :
    let D := component M I a
    let aD : D := ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
    let z : W := longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
    let y : W := longest cs D hD (D \ {a}) Set.sdiff_subset
    let K := Set.insert a I \ {(opposition cs D hD aD : S)}
    SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I a ha hD = (y * z, K, fun x => (x * (y * z), K)) := rfl

theorem crossing_data_component (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (K D : Set S) (b : S)
    (hb : b ∉ K) (hbD : b ∈ D) (hc : component M K b = D)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) (hD' : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M K b))) :
    let z : W := longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
    let t : W := longest cs D hD (D \ {b}) Set.sdiff_subset
    let L := Set.insert b K \ {(opposition cs D hD ⟨b, hbD⟩ : S)}
    SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs K b hb hD' = (t * z, L, fun x => (x * (t * z), L)) := by
  subst D
  exact crossing_data cs K b hb hD'

theorem max_unique (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (L : Set S) (z t : cs.parabolic L)
    (hz : ∀ u : cs.parabolic L, cs.length (u : W) ≤ cs.length (z : W))
    (ht : ∀ u : cs.parabolic L, cs.length (u : W) ≤ cs.length (t : W)) : z = t := by
  have hl : cs.length (z : W) = cs.length (t : W) := le_antisymm (ht z) (hz t)
  have hc := max_complement cs L z hz (t : W) t.property
  have hzt : (z : W) * t = 1 := cs.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega)
  have hzz := (oppositionWork cs L z hz).1
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    (z : W) = z * ((z : W) * t) := by rw [hzt, mul_one]
    _ = t := by rw [← mul_assoc, hzz, one_mul]

theorem conjugate_length (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (D : Set S)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) (u : W) (hu : u ∈ cs.parabolic D) :
    let z : W := longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
    cs.length (z * u * z) = cs.length u := by
  let z := longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
  have zz := (opposition_certified cs D hD).1
  have hz := longest_max cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
  have h1 := max_complement cs D z hz u⁻¹ ((cs.parabolic D).inv_mem hu)
  have h2 := max_complement cs D z hz ((z : W) * u * z)
    ((cs.parabolic D).mul_mem ((cs.parabolic D).mul_mem z.property hu) z.property)
  have hi : (z : W)⁻¹ = z := inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left zz
  have hh : cs.length ((z : W) * u⁻¹) = cs.length (u * z) := by
    rw [← cs.length_inv ((z : W) * u⁻¹), mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, hi]
  have hc : (z : W) * ((z : W) * u * z) = u * z := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, zz, one_mul]
  rw [hh, cs.length_inv] at h1
  rw [hc] at h2
  change cs.length ((z : W) * u * z) = cs.length u
  omega

theorem conjugate_mem (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (z : W) (zz : z * z = 1)
    (L L' : Set S)
    (hs : ∀ i ∈ L, ∃ k ∈ L', z * cs.simple i * z = cs.simple k)
    (u : W) (hu : u ∈ cs.parabolic L) : z * u * z ∈ cs.parabolic L' := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := cs.exists_wordProd_eq_of_mem_parabolic hu
  induction v with
  | nil => simpa only [cs.wordProd_nil, mul_one, zz] using (cs.parabolic L').one_mem
  | cons i v ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := hs i (hv i (by simp))
    have htail := ih (fun j hj => hv j (by simp [hj]))
      (cs.wordProd_mem_parabolic (fun j hj => hv j (by simp [hj])))
    rw [cs.wordProd_cons]
    have heq : z * (cs.simple i * cs.wordProd v) * z =
        (z * cs.simple i * z) * (z * cs.wordProd v * z) := by
      simp only [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc z z, zz, one_mul]
    rw [heq, he]
    exact (cs.parabolic L').mul_mem (cs.simple_mem_parabolic hk) htail

theorem longest_conjugate (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (D : Set S)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) (a : D) :
    let b : S := opposition cs D hD a
    let z : W := longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
    let y : W := longest cs D hD (D \ {(a : S)}) Set.sdiff_subset
    (longest cs D hD (D \ {b}) Set.sdiff_subset : W) = z * y * z := by
  classical
  let ν := opposition cs D hD
  let z : W := longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
  let E := D \ {(a : S)}
  let F := D \ {(ν a : S)}
  let y := longest cs D hD E Set.sdiff_subset
  let t := longest cs D hD F Set.sdiff_subset
  obtain ⟨zz, hνinv, hroot, hgen⟩ := opposition_certified cs D hD
  have hi : z⁻¹ = z := inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left zz
  have hEF : ∀ i ∈ E, ∃ k ∈ F, z * cs.simple i * z = cs.simple k := by
    intro i hiE
    let iD : D := ⟨i, hiE.1⟩
    refine ⟨ν iD, ⟨(ν iD).property, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro he
      have h := ν.injective (Subtype.ext he : ν iD = ν a)
      exact hiE.2 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    · have hg : z * cs.simple (iD : S) * z⁻¹ = cs.simple (ν iD : S) := hgen iD
      simpa only [hi] using hg
  have hFE : ∀ i ∈ F, ∃ k ∈ E, z * cs.simple i * z = cs.simple k := by
    intro i hiF
    let iD : D := ⟨i, hiF.1⟩
    refine ⟨ν iD, ⟨(ν iD).property, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro he
      have h : ν iD = a := Subtype.ext he
      have hh : iD = ν a := by rw [← hνinv iD, h]
      exact hiF.2 (congrArg Subtype.val hh)
    · have hg : z * cs.simple (iD : S) * z⁻¹ = cs.simple (ν iD : S) := hgen iD
      simpa only [hi] using hg
  let p : cs.parabolic F := ⟨z * y * z, conjugate_mem cs z zz E F hEF y y.property⟩
  have hp : ∀ u : cs.parabolic F, cs.length (u : W) ≤ cs.length (p : W) := by
    intro u
    have hmem := conjugate_mem cs z zz F E hFE u u.property
    have hmax := longest_max cs D hD E Set.sdiff_subset ⟨_, hmem⟩
    have hlenU := conjugate_length cs D hD u (cs.parabolic_mono Set.sdiff_subset u.property)
    have hlenY := conjugate_length cs D hD y (cs.parabolic_mono Set.sdiff_subset y.property)
    change cs.length (z * u * z) ≤ cs.length (y : W) at hmax
    change cs.length (u : W) ≤ cs.length (z * y * z)
    rw [hlenY]
    rwa [hlenU] at hmax
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (max_unique cs F t p (longest_max cs D hD F Set.sdiff_subset) hp)

theorem insert_complement (L : Set S) (b : S) (hb : b ∈ L) :
    Set.insert b (L \ {b}) = L := by
  classical
  ext i
  change (i = b ∨ (i ∈ L ∧ i ≠ b)) ↔ i ∈ L
  by_cases h : i = b
  · subst i
    simp [hb]
  · simp [h]

theorem component_reroot (M : CoxeterMatrix S) (I : Set S) (a b : S)
    (hb : b ∈ component M I a) :
    component M (Set.insert a I \ {b}) b = component M I a := by
  let R := fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert a I ∧ j ∈ Set.insert a I ∧
    i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2
  have hsymm : ∀ i j, R i j → R j i := by
    intro i j h
    exact ⟨h.2.1, h.1, h.2.2.1.symm, by rw [M.symmetric]; exact h.2.2.2⟩
  have rev : ∀ {i j}, Relation.ReflTransGen R i j → Relation.ReflTransGen R j i := by
    intro i j h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact .refl
    | tail h hlast ih => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head (hsymm _ _ hlast) ih
  have hab : Relation.ReflTransGen R a b := hb.2
  have hba := rev hab
  have hset := insert_complement (Set.insert a I) b hb.1
  unfold component
  rw [hset]
  ext i
  constructor
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨hi.1, hab.trans hi.2⟩
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨hi.1, hba.trans hi.2⟩

theorem reverse_crossing (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S) (a : S)
    (ha : a ∉ I) (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M I a))) :
    let D := component M I a
    let aD : D := ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
    let b : S := opposition cs D hD aD
    let forward := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I a ha hD
    b ∈ D ∧ Set.insert b forward.2.1 = Set.insert a I ∧
    component M forward.2.1 b = D ∧
    ∃ (hb : b ∉ forward.2.1)
      (hD' : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M forward.2.1 b))),
      let reverse := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs forward.2.1 b hb hD'
      reverse.2.1 = I ∧ reverse.1 = forward.1⁻¹ ∧
      forward.1 * reverse.1 = 1 ∧ reverse.1 * forward.1 = 1 ∧
      (∀ x : W, reverse.2.2 (forward.2.2 x).1 = (x, I)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := component M I a
  let aD : D := ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  let ν := opposition cs D hD
  let b : S := ν aD
  let K : Set S := Set.insert a I \ {b}
  let z : W := longest cs D hD D (fun _ h => h)
  let y : W := longest cs D hD (D \ {a}) Set.sdiff_subset
  let t : W := longest cs D hD (D \ {b}) Set.sdiff_subset
  have hdata := crossing_data cs I a ha hD
  change SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I a ha hD =
    (y * z, K, fun x => (x * (y * z), K)) at hdata
  rw [hdata]
  dsimp only
  have hbD : b ∈ D := (ν aD).property
  have hbL : b ∈ Set.insert a I := hbD.1
  have hb : b ∉ K := fun h => h.2 rfl
  have hset : Set.insert b K = Set.insert a I := insert_complement _ _ hbL
  have hcomp : component M K b = D := component_reroot M I a b hbD
  have hD' : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M K b)) := hcomp.symm ▸ hD
  refine ⟨hbD, hset, hcomp, hb, hD', ?_⟩
  have hreverse := crossing_data_component cs K D b hb hbD hcomp hD hD'
  have hνinv := (opposition_certified cs D hD).2.1
  have hop : (ν ⟨b,hbD⟩ : S) = a := congrArg Subtype.val (hνinv aD)
  have htarget : Set.insert b K \ {(ν ⟨b,hbD⟩ : S)} = I := by
    rw [hop, hset]
    apply Set.ext
    intro i
    change ((i = a ∨ i ∈ I) ∧ i ≠ a) ↔ i ∈ I
    aesop
  change SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs K b hb hD' =
    (t * z, Set.insert b K \ {(ν ⟨b,hbD⟩ : S)},
      fun x => (x * (t * z), Set.insert b K \ {(ν ⟨b,hbD⟩ : S)})) at hreverse
  rw [htarget] at hreverse
  rw [hreverse]
  dsimp only
  have zz := (opposition_certified cs D hD).1
  have yy := (oppositionWork cs (D \ {a})
    (longest cs D hD (D \ {a}) Set.sdiff_subset)
    (longest_max cs D hD (D \ {a}) Set.sdiff_subset)).1
  have hconj : t = z * y * z := longest_conjugate cs D hD aD
  have hzInv : z⁻¹ = z := inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left zz
  have hyInv : y⁻¹ = y := inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left yy
  have hlabel : t * z = (y * z)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hconj, mul_assoc (z * y) z z, zz, mul_one, mul_inv_rev, hzInv, hyInv]
  refine ⟨rfl, hlabel, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hlabel, mul_inv_cancel]
  · rw [hlabel, inv_mul_cancel]
  · intro x
    rw [hlabel, mul_inv_cancel_right]

theorem opposition_index_component (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (K D : Set S) (b : S)
    (hbD : b ∈ D) (hc : component M K b = D)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic D)) (hD' : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M K b))) :
    (opposition cs (component M K b) hD'
      ⟨b, Set.mem_insert b K, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩ : S) =
      (opposition cs D hD ⟨b, hbD⟩ : S) := by
  subst D
  rfl

theorem reverse_opposition_index (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (I : Set S) (a : S)
    (ha : a ∉ I) (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M I a))) :
    let D := component M I a
    let aD : D := ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
    let b : S := opposition cs D hD aD
    let forward := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I a ha hD
    ∀ hD' : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M forward.2.1 b)),
      (opposition cs (component M forward.2.1 b) hD'
        ⟨b, Set.mem_insert b forward.2.1, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩ : S) = a := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := component M I a
  let aD : D := ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  let ν := opposition cs D hD
  let b : S := ν aD
  let K := Set.insert a I \ {b}
  rw [crossing_data cs I a ha hD]
  dsimp only
  intro hD'
  have hbD : b ∈ D := (ν aD).property
  have hc : component M K b = D := component_reroot M I a b hbD
  have htransport := opposition_index_component cs K D b hbD hc hD hD'
  rw [htransport]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((opposition_certified cs D hD).2.1 aD)

theorem tagged_inverse (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J I : Set S)
    (hI : ∃ w : W, (cs.parabolic I).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom = cs.parabolic J)
    (a : S) (ha : a ∉ I) (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M I a))) :
    let D := component M I a
    let aD : D := ⟨a, Set.mem_insert a I, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
    let b : S := opposition cs D hD aD
    let forward := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I a ha hD
    ∃ (hK : ∃ w : W, (cs.parabolic forward.2.1).map (MulAut.conj w).toMonoidHom =
        cs.parabolic J)
      (f : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom ⟨I, hI⟩ ⟨forward.2.1, hK⟩)
      (hb : b ∉ forward.2.1)
      (hD' : Finite (cs.parabolic (component M forward.2.1 b))),
      let reverse := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs forward.2.1 b hb hD'
      ∃ g : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom ⟨forward.2.1, hK⟩ ⟨I, hI⟩,
        f.val = forward.1 ∧ g.val = reverse.1 ∧ reverse.2.1 = I ∧
        f.val * g.val = 1 ∧ g.val * f.val = 1 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨hK, f, hf⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J I hI a ha hD
  obtain ⟨hbD, hset, hcomp, hb, hD', ht, hl, hp, hp' , hx⟩ := reverse_crossing cs I a ha hD
  let g := (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv f
  refine ⟨hK, f, hb, hD', g, hf, ?_, ht, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change f.val⁻¹ = _
    rw [hf, hl]
  · change f.val * f.val⁻¹ = 1
    exact mul_inv_cancel _
  · change f.val⁻¹ * f.val = 1
    exact inv_mul_cancel _

end ReverseCrossing

#print axioms ReverseCrossing.crossing_data
#print axioms ReverseCrossing.opposition_certified
#print axioms ReverseCrossing.longest_conjugate
#print axioms ReverseCrossing.reverse_crossing
#print axioms ReverseCrossing.reverse_opposition_index
#print axioms ReverseCrossing.tagged_inverse

Portal inspiration: rank-two-standard-words steps 1.1, 2.1 and

namespace CorankTwoContinuation
section Generic
variable {A O W : Type*} [Group W] {S : Type*} {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (value : A → W)

def product (es : List A) : W := (es.map value).prod
def weight (es : List A) : Nat := (es.map (fun e => cs.length (value e))).sum

theorem weight_bound (es : List A) : cs.length (product value es) ≤ weight cs value es := by
  induction es with
  | nil => simp [product, weight]
  | cons e es ih =>
    exact (cs.length_mul_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _) 

theorem tail_additive (e : A) (es : List A)
    (h : cs.length (product value (e :: es)) = weight cs value (e :: es)) :
    cs.length (product value es) = weight cs value es := by
  have hb := weight_bound cs value es
  have hm := cs.length_mul_le (value e) (product value es)
  change cs.length (value e * product value es) = cs.length (value e) + weight cs value es at h
  omega

theorem no_inverse_head (e f : A) (es : List A)
    (hp : 0 < cs.length (value e))
    (h : cs.length (product value (e :: f :: es)) = weight cs value (e :: f :: es)) :
    value e * value f ≠ 1 := by
  intro hinv
  have hb := weight_bound cs value es
  have heq : product value (e :: f :: es) = product value es := by
    change value e * (value f * product value es) = product value es
    rw [← mul_assoc, hinv, one_mul]
  rw [heq] at h
  change cs.length (product value es) =
    cs.length (value e) + (cs.length (value f) + weight cs value es) at h
  omega

variable (src tgt : A → O) (allowed : A → Prop)

def Walk (p : A) (es : List A) : Prop :=
  es.foldr (fun e tail prev => allowed e ∧ src e = tgt prev ∧
    value prev * value e ≠ 1 ∧ tail e) (fun _ => True) p

theorem next_unique
    (hTwo : ∀ e f r : A, allowed e → allowed f → allowed r →
      src e = src f → src e = src r → e = f ∨ e = r ∨ f = r)
    (hRev : ∀ p : A, allowed p → ∃ r : A,
      allowed r ∧ src r = tgt p ∧ value p * value r = 1)
    {p e f : A} (hp : allowed p) (he : allowed e) (hf : allowed f)
    (hse : src e = tgt p) (hsf : src f = tgt p)
    (hne : value p * value e ≠ 1) (hnf : value p * value f ≠ 1) : e = f := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsr, hinv⟩ := hRev p hp
  rcases hTwo e f r he hf hr (hse.trans hsf.symm) (hse.trans hsr.symm) with h | h | h
  · exact h
  · subst e; exact False.elim (hne hinv)
  · subst f; exact False.elim (hnf hinv)

theorem continuation_unique
    (hTwo : ∀ e f r : A, allowed e → allowed f → allowed r →
      src e = src f → src e = src r → e = f ∨ e = r ∨ f = r)
    (hRev : ∀ p : A, allowed p → ∃ r : A,
      allowed r ∧ src r = tgt p ∧ value p * value r = 1)
    (es fs : List A) (p : A) (hp : allowed p)
    (he : Walk value src tgt allowed p es) (hf : Walk value src tgt allowed p fs)
    (hlen : es.length = fs.length) : es = fs := by
  induction es generalizing fs p with
  | nil => cases fs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons f fs => simp at hlen
  | cons e es ih =>
    cases fs with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons f fs =>
      have hef : e = f := next_unique value src tgt allowed hTwo hRev hp
        he.1 hf.1 he.2.1 hf.2.1 he.2.2.1 hf.2.2.1
      subst f
      exact congrArg (List.cons e) (ih fs e he.1 he.2.2.2 hf.2.2.2 (by simpa using hlen))

/-- Read the concrete foldr composability predicate without constructing suffix arrows. -/
theorem standard_walk (es : List A) (L K : O)
    (hc : es.foldr (fun e tail N => N = src e ∧ tail (tgt e))
      (fun N => N = K) L)
    (ha : ∀ e ∈ es, allowed e)
    (hp : ∀ e : A, allowed e → 0 < cs.length (value e))
    (hadd : cs.length (product value es) = weight cs value es) :
    ∀ p tail, es = p :: tail → Walk value src tgt allowed p tail := by
  induction es generalizing L with
  | nil => intro p tail h; cases h
  | cons e es ih =>
    intro p tail h
    cases h
    cases es with
    | nil => trivial
    | cons f fs =>
      refine ⟨ha f (by simp), hc.2.1.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact no_inverse_head cs value e f fs (hp e (ha e (by simp))) hadd
      · exact ih (tgt e) hc.2 (fun a h => ha a (by simp [h]))

section Concrete
variable {S W : Type*} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix S}
variable (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (J : Set S)

abbrev Obj := {L : Set S // ∃ g : W,
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) (cs.parabolic L) = cs.parabolic J}
def component (L : Set S) (c : S) : Set S :=
  {d | d ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen
    (fun i j : S => i ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ j ∈ Set.insert c L ∧ i ≠ j ∧ M i j ≠ 2) c d}
abbrev Atom := {p : Obj cs J × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧
  Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) p.1.val p.2))}
def crossing (e : Atom cs J) :=
  SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
abbrev src (e : Atom cs J) : Set S := e.val.1.val
abbrev tgt (e : Atom cs J) : Set S := (crossing cs J e).2.1
abbrev value (e : Atom cs J) : W := (crossing cs J e).1

def InResidue (T : Set S) (e : Atom cs J) : Prop :=
  src cs J e ⊆ T ∧ e.val.2 ∈ T ∧
  ∃ c d : S, c ≠ d ∧ T \ src cs J e = {c, d}

theorem atom_ext {e f : Atom cs J} (hs : src cs J e = src cs J f)
    (hi : e.val.2 = f.val.2) : e = f := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hs) hi

theorem residue_missing {T : Set S} {e : Atom cs J} (he : InResidue cs J T e)
    {c d : S} (hcd : T \ src cs J e = {c, d}) : e.val.2 = c ∨ e.val.2 = d := by
  have h : e.val.2 ∈ T \ src cs J e := ⟨he.2.1, e.property.1⟩
  rw [hcd] at h
  simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h

theorem two_outgoing (T : Set S) (e f r : Atom cs J)
    (he : InResidue cs J T e) (hf : InResidue cs J T f) (hr : InResidue cs J T r)
    (hsf : src cs J e = src cs J f) (hsr : src cs J e = src cs J r) :
    e = f ∨ e = r ∨ f = r := by
  obtain ⟨c, d, hne, hcd⟩ := he.2.2
  have hfcd : T \ src cs J f = {c,d} := hsf ▸ hcd
  have hrcd : T \ src cs J r = {c,d} := hsr ▸ hcd
  rcases residue_missing cs J he hcd with hec | hed <;>
    rcases residue_missing cs J hf hfcd with hfc | hfd <;>
    rcases residue_missing cs J hr hrcd with hrc | hrd
  · exact Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsf (hec.trans hfc.symm))
  · exact Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsf (hec.trans hfc.symm))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsr (hec.trans hrc.symm)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (atom_ext cs J (hsf.symm.trans hsr) (hfd.trans hrd.symm)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (atom_ext cs J (hsf.symm.trans hsr) (hfc.trans hrc.symm)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsr (hed.trans hrd.symm)))
  · exact Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsf (hed.trans hfd.symm))
  · exact Or.inl (atom_ext cs J hsf (hed.trans hfd.symm))

theorem standard_same_first (T : Set S)
    (hPos : ∀ p : Atom cs J, InResidue cs J T p → 0 < cs.length (value cs J p))
    (hRev : ∀ p : Atom cs J, InResidue cs J T p → ∃ r : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J T r ∧ src cs J r = tgt cs J p ∧ value cs J p * value cs J r = 1)
    {I K : Obj cs J} {q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K}
    (e f : StandardExpressions cs J I K q)
    (he : ∀ p ∈ e.val, InResidue cs J T p)
    (hf : ∀ p ∈ f.val, InResidue cs J T p)
    (p : Atom cs J) (es fs : List (Atom cs J))
    (hes : e.val = p :: es) (hfs : f.val = p :: fs) : e = f := by
  have hcount := (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K q e f
  have headd : cs.length (product (value cs J) e.val) = weight cs (value cs J) e.val := by
    rw [show product (value cs J) e.val = q.val from e.property.2.1]
    exact e.property.2.2
  have hfadd : cs.length (product (value cs J) f.val) = weight cs (value cs J) f.val := by
    rw [show product (value cs J) f.val = q.val from f.property.2.1]
    exact f.property.2.2
  have hewalk := standard_walk cs (value cs J) (src cs J) (tgt cs J)
    (InResidue cs J T) e.val I.val K.val e.property.1 he hPos headd p es hes
  have hfwalk := standard_walk cs (value cs J) (src cs J) (tgt cs J)
    (InResidue cs J T) f.val I.val K.val f.property.1 hf hPos hfadd p fs hfs
  have hp := he p (by rw [hes]; exact List.mem_cons_self)
  have hlen : es.length = fs.length := by rw [hes, hfs] at hcount; exact Nat.succ.inj hcount
  have htail := continuation_unique (value cs J) (src cs J) (tgt cs J)
    (InResidue cs J T) (two_outgoing cs J T) hRev es fs p hp hewalk hfwalk hlen
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [hes, hfs, htail]

/-- Construct a standard word with the specified atom, using an additive prefix. -/
theorem standard_with_first_of_prefix (I K : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K) (a : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val)
    (hD : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val a)))
    (hprefix : cs.length q.val =
      cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hD).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hD).1⁻¹ * q.val)) :
    ∃ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ∃ es, e.val = (⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hD⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es := by
  let c := SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hD
  obtain ⟨hL, f, hf⟩ := ElementaryWallMorphism cs J I.val I.property a ha hD
  let L : Obj cs J := ⟨c.2.1, hL⟩
  let z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom L K :=
    (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv f) q
  have hz : z.val = c.1⁻¹ * q.val := by change f.val⁻¹ * q.val = _; rw [hf]
  obtain ⟨ez⟩ := (StandardFactorCount cs J L K z).1
  let p : Atom cs J := ⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hD⟩⟩
  let e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q := by
    refine ⟨p :: ez.val, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨rfl, ez.property.1⟩
    · change c.1 * (ez.val.map (value cs J)).prod = q.val
      rw [show (ez.val.map (value cs J)).prod = z.val from ez.property.2.1, hz]
      exact mul_inv_cancel_left _ _
    · change cs.length q.val = cs.length c.1 +
        (ez.val.map (fun e => cs.length (value cs J e))).sum
      rw [← show cs.length z.val =
        (ez.val.map (fun e => cs.length (value cs J e))).sum from ez.property.2.2, hz]
      exact hprefix
  exact ⟨e, ez.val, rfl⟩

/-- Conditional classification. The confinement, positivity and reverse inputs
are explicit; this theorem does not prove them. -/
theorem rank_two_standard_words_of_residue
    (T : Set S) (I K : Obj cs J) (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hDa : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val a)))
    (hDb : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val b)))
    (hMissing : T \ I.val = {a,b})
    (hConf : ∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ∀ p ∈ e.val, InResidue cs J T p)
    (hPos : ∀ p : Atom cs J, InResidue cs J T p → 0 < cs.length (value cs J p))
    (hRev : ∀ p : Atom cs J, InResidue cs J T p → ∃ r : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J T r ∧ src cs J r = tgt cs J p ∧ value cs J p * value cs J r = 1)
    (ea eb : StandardExpressions cs J I K q)
    (hstarta : ∃ es, ea.val = (⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es)
    (hstartb : ∃ es, eb.val = (⟨(I,b), ⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es) :
    ea ≠ eb ∧ (∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q, e = ea ∨ e = eb) ∧
      ea.val.length = eb.val.length := by
  let pa : Atom cs J := ⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩
  let pb : Atom cs J := ⟨(I,b), ⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨as, has⟩ := hstarta
  obtain ⟨bs, hbs⟩ := hstartb
  have hne : ea ≠ eb := by
    intro h
    have hh : pa :: as = pb :: bs := has.symm.trans ((congrArg Subtype.val h).trans hbs)
    have hatom : pa = pb := (List.cons.inj hh).1
    exact hab (congrArg (fun p : Atom cs J => p.val.2) hatom)
  refine ⟨hne, ?_, (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K q ea eb⟩
  intro e
  have hcount := (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K q e ea
  cases hes : e.val with
  | nil => rw [hes, has] at hcount; simp at hcount
  | cons p es =>
    have hcomp := e.property.1
    change e.val.foldr (fun p tail N => N = src cs J p ∧ tail (tgt cs J p))
      (fun N => N = K.val) I.val at hcomp
    rw [hes] at hcomp
    have hsrc : src cs J p = I.val := hcomp.1.symm
    have hp := hConf e p (by rw [hes]; exact List.mem_cons_self)
    have hi : p.val.2 ∈ T \ I.val := ⟨hp.2.1, hsrc ▸ p.property.1⟩
    rw [hMissing] at hi
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hi with hia | hib
    · have hpa : p = pa := atom_ext cs J hsrc hia
      have hep : e.val = pa :: es := by rw [hes, hpa]; rfl
      exact Or.inl (standard_same_first cs J T hPos hRev e ea
        (hConf e) (hConf ea) pa es as hep has)
    · have hpb : p = pb := atom_ext cs J hsrc (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hib)
      have hep : e.val = pb :: es := by rw [hes, hpb]; rfl
      exact Or.inr (standard_same_first cs J T hPos hRev e eb
        (hConf e) (hConf eb) pb es bs hep hbs)

/-- Complete assembly from the two additive prefixes and the three residue inputs.
No exactly-two word assertion is assumed. The finite-relative-root hypothesis is
used by the caller to establish the inputs, not silently added to an ambient type. -/
theorem rank_two_of_prefixes (I K : Obj cs J)
    (q : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom I K)
    (a b : S) (ha : a ∉ I.val) (hb : b ∉ I.val) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hDa : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val a)))
    (hDb : Finite (cs.parabolic (component (M := M) I.val b)))
    (hpa : cs.length q.val =
      cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hDa).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val a ha hDa).1⁻¹ * q.val))
    (hpb : cs.length q.val =
      cs.length (SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val b hb hDb).1 +
      cs.length ((SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs I.val b hb hDb).1⁻¹ * q.val))
    (hConf : ∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ∀ p ∈ e.val, InResidue cs J (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) p)
    (hPos : ∀ p : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) p → 0 < cs.length (value cs J p))
    (hRev : ∀ p : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) p → ∃ r : Atom cs J,
      InResidue cs J (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) r ∧
      src cs J r = tgt cs J p ∧ value cs J p * value cs J r = 1) :
    ∃ ea eb : StandardExpressions cs J I K q,
      ea ≠ eb ∧ (∀ e : StandardExpressions cs J I K q, e = ea ∨ e = eb) ∧
      ea.val.length = eb.val.length ∧
      (∃ es, ea.val = (⟨(I,a), ⟨ha,hDa⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es) ∧
      (∃ es, eb.val = (⟨(I,b), ⟨hb,hDb⟩⟩ : Atom cs J) :: es) := by
  obtain ⟨ea, hsa⟩ := standard_with_first_of_prefix cs J I K q a ha hDa hpa
  obtain ⟨eb, hsb⟩ := standard_with_first_of_prefix cs J I K q b hb hDb hpb
  have hMissing : (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) \ I.val = {a,b} := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hc, hn⟩
      rcases hc with rfl | rfl | hc
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl
      · exact False.elim (hn hc)
    · intro hc
      rcases hc with rfl | hc
      · exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, ha⟩
      · have hcb : c = b := hc
        subst c
        exact ⟨Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), hb⟩
  obtain ⟨hne, honly, hlen⟩ := rank_two_standard_words_of_residue cs J
    (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) I K q a b ha hb hab hDa hDb
    hMissing hConf hPos hRev ea eb hsa hsb
  exact ⟨ea, eb, hne, honly, hlen, hsa, hsb⟩
end Concrete

      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := I.property
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hKI

        simp [MulAut.conj_apply, mul_assoc]

    have hNq : N q.val = (parabolicRoots T ∩ positiveRoots) \

      rintro α ⟨u, hu, i, hi, he⟩
      exact ⟨u, cs.parabolic_mono h hu, i, h hi, he⟩

        α ∈ N x ↔ α ∈ cs.geometricRoots ∧ 0 < α ∧ cs.geometricRepresentation x⁻¹ α < 0 := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hp, β, hn, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2, by simpa only [Representation.inv_self_apply] using hn.2⟩
      · rintro ⟨hr, hp, hn⟩

          ⟨(cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff x⁻¹).mpr hr, hn⟩, ?_⟩
        exact Representation.self_inv_apply _ _ _

      apply (ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.length_eq_add_iff_rootInversions_subset_system cs x y).mpr
      intro α hr hp hn
      exact ((image_N y α).mp (h ((image_N x α).mpr ⟨hr, hp, hn⟩))).2.2
    -- Step 2.1: the elementary inversion formula is proved above.
    have hNa : N va = (parabolicRoots (Set.insert a I.val) ∩ positiveRoots) \
        (parabolicRoots I.val ∩ positiveRoots) :=
      ElementaryRootInversions cs I.val a ha hDa
    have hNb : N vb = (parabolicRoots (Set.insert b I.val) ∩ positiveRoots) \
        (parabolicRoots I.val ∩ positiveRoots) :=
      ElementaryRootInversions cs I.val b hb hDb
    have hpa : leftDiv va q.val := by
      apply prefix_of_N
      rw [hNa, hNq]
      intro α hα
      refine ⟨⟨roots_mono ?_ hα.1.1, hα.1.2⟩, hα.2⟩
      intro i hi
      exact hi.elim (fun h => h ▸ Set.mem_insert a _) (fun h => Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ h))
    have hpb : leftDiv vb q.val := by
      apply prefix_of_N
      rw [hNb, hNq]
      intro α hα
      refine ⟨⟨roots_mono ?_ hα.1.1, hα.1.2⟩, hα.2⟩
      exact fun i hi => Set.mem_insert_of_mem a hi
    -- Step 2.1: classification by confinement and deterministic continuation.
    obtain ⟨ea, eb, hne, honly, hstarta, hstartb⟩ :=
      f0 cs J I K a b ha hb hab hfin hDa hDb q hNq hpa hpb
    refine ⟨K, q, ea, eb, hpa, hpb, hne, honly,
      (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K q ea eb, hstarta, hstartb, ?_⟩
    intro K' w hwa hwb
    -- Step 2.2: simultaneous prefix is proved by finite-support coordinates.
    have hqw : leftDiv q.val w.val := by
      apply prefix_of_N
      have prefix_N {u v : W} (h : leftDiv u v) : N u ⊆ N v := by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨hr, hp, hn⟩ := (image_N u x).mp hx
        exact (image_N v x).mpr ⟨hr, hp,
          (ArtinNormalisers.Chamber3.length_eq_add_iff_rootInversions_subset_system cs u v).mp h x hr hp hn⟩
      have seed (c : S) (hc : c ∉ I.val) (v : W)
          (hNv : N v = (parabolicRoots (Set.insert c I.val) ∩ positiveRoots) \
            (parabolicRoots I.val ∩ positiveRoots)) (hv : leftDiv v w.val) :
          cs.geometricRepresentation w.val⁻¹ (Finsupp.single c (1 : ℝ)) < 0 := by
        have hr : Finsupp.single c (1 : ℝ) ∈ cs.geometricRoots := ⟨1, c, by simp⟩

          exact lt_of_le_of_ne (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr (by norm_num)) (by intro he; have hh := congrArg (fun z : S →₀ ℝ => z c) he; simp at hh)
        have hmem : Finsupp.single c (1 : ℝ) ∈ N v := by
          rw [hNv]
          refine ⟨⟨⟨1, (cs.parabolic _).one_mem, c, Or.inl rfl, by simp⟩, hr, hp⟩, ?_⟩
          intro hh
          have hz := supported cs I.val hh.1 c hc
          simp at hz
        exact ((image_N w.val _).mp (prefix_N hv hmem)).2.2
      have han := seed a ha va hNa hwa
      have hbn := seed b hb vb hNb hwb

      have hw : act w.val '' piRoots K'.val = piRoots I.val := w.property
      have hinv := inverse_image w.val K'.val I.val hw
      have neg_outside (c : S) (hc : c ∉ I.val) (hcneg : act w.val⁻¹ (root c) < 0) :

          intro hz

        obtain ⟨hk, hne⟩ := not_imp.mp hk
        exact ⟨k, hk, lt_of_le_of_ne (hcneg.le k) hne⟩

        by_contra hn
        push_neg at hn
        have hxa : x a = 0 := le_antisymm hn.1 (hp.le a)
        have hxb : x b = 0 := le_antisymm hn.2 (hp.le b)

        apply positive_supported_root_mem_parabolic I.val x hr hp

        by_cases hka : k = a
        · subst k; exact hxa
        by_cases hkb : k = b
        · subst k; exact hxb

          rintro (he | he | hi)
          · exact hka he
          · exact hkb he
          · exact hk hi)
      let t := x - x a • root a - x b • root b

        intro k hk
        by_cases hka : k = a
        · subst k
          simp [t, root, Finsupp.single_apply, hab]
        by_cases hkb : k = b
        · subst k
          simp [t, root, Finsupp.single_apply, hab.symm]
        have hz := supported cs (Set.insert a (Set.insert b I.val)) hxT k (by
          rintro (he | he | hi)
          · exact hka he
          · exact hkb he
          · exact hk hi)
        simp [t, root, hz, Finsupp.single_apply, hka, hkb]

          act w.val⁻¹ x k = x a * act w.val⁻¹ (root a) k + x b * act w.val⁻¹ (root b) k := by
        have hh := image_support w.val⁻¹ I.val K'.val hinv t ht k hk

          Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hh

      have hnegcoord : ∃ k, act w.val⁻¹ x k < 0 := by
        rcases habpos with hxa | hxb
        · obtain ⟨k, hk, hak⟩ := neg_outside a ha han
          refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
          rw [coord k hk]
          have hlt := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hxa hak
          have hle := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hp.le b) (hbn.le k)
          linarith
        · obtain ⟨k, hk, hbk⟩ := neg_outside b hb hbn
          refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
          rw [coord k hk]
          have hlt := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hxb hbk
          have hle := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hp.le a) (han.le k)
          linarith

        rcases cs.pos_or_neg_of_mem_geometricRoots
          ((cs.geometricRepresentation_apply_mem_geometricRoots_iff _).mpr hr) with hpos | hneg

          exact False.elim ((hpos.le k).not_gt hk)

    let z : (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).Hom K K' :=
      (BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).comp ((BrinkHowlettGroupoid cs J).inv q) w
    have hz : z.val = q.val⁻¹ * w.val := rfl
    obtain ⟨ez⟩ := (StandardFactorCount cs J K K' z).1
    let Atom := {p : Obj × S // p.2 ∉ p.1.val ∧
      Finite (cs.parabolic (component p.1.val p.2))}
    let crossing := fun e : Atom =>
      SimpleWallCrossings S W M cs e.val.1.val e.val.2 e.property.1 e.property.2
    let composable := fun (es : List Atom) (L F : Set S) =>
      List.foldr (fun e tail N => N = e.val.1.val ∧ tail (crossing e).2.1)
        (fun N => N = F) es L

      induction es generalizing L with
      | nil =>
        change L = F at hes
        subst L
        exact hfs
      | cons e es ih =>
        exact ⟨hes.1, ih _ hes.2⟩
    let ecat : StandardExpressions cs J I K' w := by
      refine ⟨ea.val ++ ez.val, comp_append ea.val ez.val I.val K.val K'.val ea.property.1 ez.property.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [List.map_append, List.prod_append, ea.property.2.1, ez.property.2.1, hz]
        exact mul_inv_cancel_left _ _
      · simp only [List.map_append, List.sum_append, ← ea.property.2.2, ← ez.property.2.2, hz]
        exact hqw
    intro e
    have hcount := (GeneratorsAndStandardLength cs J).2 I K' w ecat e
    change List.length (ea.val ++ ez.val) = List.length e.val at hcount
    rw [List.length_append] at hcount
    rw [← hcount]
    exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  )
